about_the_game:
🐾 NoSlack Pets: Lo-Fi Paws (Demo)

Welcome to the NoSlack Pets: Lo-Fi Paws Demo!
Here’s what you can experience in this trial version:

  • Free Mode with 8 adorable cats (20+ cats in full release)

  • 8 Normal Headgear (280+ in full release; headgear synthesis not available in demo)

  • A selection of skins, headgear, expressions, and house/desktop decorations (at least 8 types per category in demo; all available in full release)

  • 20+ Lo-Fi tracks & 10 white noise sounds (39+ tracks & 36 noises in full release)

  • Core features: Pomodoro Timer, Catbus, basic weather effects, limited-time events (all available in full release)

  • Daily Tasks & a few mini-games (more unlocked in full release)

👉 The full version will continuously add more content—upgrade when you’re ready to meet even more fluffy friends!

✨ NoSlack Pets: Lo-Fi Paws — A Lo-Fi Desktop Pet Companion Game ✨

Between every keystroke and screen flicker, let a cat named Miino accompany you through work, study, and relaxation.

This is a cozy mix of desktop pets, productivity tools, and decoration gameplay, designed to bring healing and focus to your daily routine.

Whether you’re working, typing, coding, gaming, studying, or just relaxing, your little companion stays by your side: typing in sync, dropping gift boxes, switching headgear, decorating homes, playing mini-games, and chilling with white noise.

🎯 “The cat is working hard to stay with you, while you’re working hard to live.”

✨ Core Features ✨

🐾 Typing Companion + Free Desktop Mode

In normal mode, your cat types on a mini keyboard in sync with your typing.

In Free Mode, it stretches, runs around the desktop, sits on the window, dances, or curls up peacefully—purely relaxing.

👉 Drag the cat anywhere on your window (>^ω^<)

💤 Idle Gameplay

For every 30 minutes idle, a Gift Box drops.
Opening it unlocks cute headgear to dress up your cat.
The full release expands to 400+ unique headgear.

🎀 Cat & Cat House DIY

Earn coins by idling, completing tasks, or leveling up, and spend them on decorations.

Customizable parts include:

  • Cat appearance: skins, headgear, eyes, mouths, keyboards, cursors

  • Cat house: walls, floors, windows, lamps, furniture, wall art, awnings, ground items, and more

✨ Headgear Collection & Synthesis

Every piece of collected headgear is recorded in your Catalog, with leaderboards to compete with friends.
Duplicates can be fused to unlock rarer headgear (synthesis not available in demo).

🍅 Productivity Tool: Pomodoro System

Start a Pomodoro Timer to boost focus. Combine it with music or white noise for better efficiency.
When time’s up, the cat reminds you to rest. Completing cycles grants coins and XP—your cat grows with you!

🎧 Lo-Fi Music Player & White Noise

Relax with dozens of high-quality Lo-Fi tracks and environmental sounds—rain, bonfire, forest, keyboard taps, and more.
(Demo offers limited selection; full release includes 39+ tracks & 36 noises)

📚 Online Study Room & Pool Party (Demo Limited)

Join virtual rooms to see rankings, meet others studying or relaxing, and share the “no slacking” vibe together.

📮 Daily Tasks & Letters

Complete small daily tasks—open a gift box, finish a Pomodoro, listen to music—to earn coins & XP.
Receive a daily letter from your cat with a surprise inside.

🎮 Mini-Game Center

Play lighthearted mini-games with daily game tickets. Earn coins & XP by clearing them—fun breaks to keep collecting.

🛒 More Features Coming Soon…

  • Steam Inventory Integration: Collected headgear will enter your Steam Backpack for trading on the Community Market.

  • Limited-Time Events: Earn rare or exclusive headgear during seasonal events, with unique fusion recipes and rankings.

  • More Interactions: Watch your pet bring even more surprises to your desktop.

  • New Mini-Games: Relaxing yet addictive casual games to relieve stress.

💡 Who Is This Game For?

  • Students, office workers, and gamers seeking productivity + companionship

  • Fans of Lo-Fi + cozy + cat vibes

  • Players who enjoy collecting, decorating, and cute casual games

  • Anyone wanting a “living, breathing companion” on their desktop

🚀 Demo Notes

Idle to collect Gift Boxes 🎁 with the following drop rate:

  • Normal Headgear: 100%

(Full release introduces Rare / Epic / Legendary drops with adjusted rates.)

✨ During the demo, some Epic headgear can be earned for free—watch announcements!

❤️ A Game That Truly Stays With You

Amid keystrokes and screen glow, let your cat keep you company—helping you focus, relax, or sneak a little break.
Bring more lightheartedness, coziness, and a touch of “you” into daily life.

👀 From the Developers

Thank you for every comment and bit of support—it’s your feedback that keeps us going through the grind.
We’re constantly polishing features, updating daily, and listening carefully to all suggestions.

📢 Follow us for updates, patch notes, and new cat surprises!
🎁 Limited headgear drops are live—add to wishlist and don’t miss out!

🔗 Join our community

  • Welcome to join our Discord to chat with us.

✨ Stay tuned—new updates, evolutions, and secret surprises await!
